notes: Quantum approximate k-list search supplies a new low-memory tuple-sieving framework. The representative k=30 point is included without claiming an improvement over the unrestricted quantum pair-sieve record. Heuristic low-memory tuple sieve in the QRAM model. Audit: Correctly classified as sequential time, not parallel depth. Added precision .29893 is not a new milestone.

extra.model: Sequential QRAM time; representative tuple size k=30; classical memory 2^{0.1395n+o(n)} and poly(n) qubits
extra.qram: Coherent access to classical memory; exponent 0.1395
